claim: One pace floor per update cannot pace a game whose displaced work varies by figure; scale the repayment by the displaced work per figure (windows or a fixed debt per figure), measured on the plain build.

evidence.text: Stretches of 20 updates ran -13.1 to +13.9%; cause: one floor on the time of a player update (332 lines), which knew nothing of what the update had displaced.
evidence.quote: Cause: one floor on the time of a player update (332 lines), which knew nothing of what the update had displaced.

evidence.text: With K alone, updates with many figures ran +10% while quiet ones ran -3%; a fixed debt per figure and a higher K flattened it, whole runs within 2%.
evidence.quote: With K alone, updates with many figures ran +10% while quiet ones ran -3%: a window scales the logic, not a per-figure cost.
